title: Amber Uruguayan Tofu Stew
description: A resinous, creamy tofu stew infused with matcha and simmered on a cedar plank for a unique flavor. This kid-friendly Uruguayan dish brings a soothing, plant-based twist to your table.

ingredients.name: Matcha powder
ingredients.notes: whisk with coconut milk to avoid clumps

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and place a cedar plank on a baking sheet for 15 minutes to warm.
Press tofu for 10 minutes, then cube into 1-inch pieces.
In a small bowl, whisk matcha powder with coconut milk until smooth.
In the oven, spread tofu, diced onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, and soy sauce on the warmed cedar plank.
Pour the matcha-coconut mixture and vegetable broth over the tofu mixture on the plank, then drizzle maple syrup.
Cover the plank tightly with aluminum foil and bake in the oven for 45 minutes, stirring once at 20 minutes.
Remove the plank from oven, stir the stew, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the creamy stew hot, optionally garnished with fresh cilantro or chopped green onions.
